title: NTR War in Another World
description:
“To protect the beloved young lady I serve, I'll NTR the enemy nation's princess generals!”

The strongest spy of the modern era is reincarnated in another world as a butler serving a minor noble family. Hidden deep within his heart are his love for his kind-hearted young lady and his vow to protect the homeland she loves at all costs.

But then, the beautiful princess generals of a neighboring kingdom boasting overwhelming military might begin their invasion.

Faced with a hopeless disparity in military strength, the man makes his decision: He'll abandon honorable warfare and operate in the shadows as a ruthless spy, devouring the enemy from within—

He'll tear bonds apart, break their hearts, and use the Honey Trap skill he's been given to steal the enemy princess generals away from their lovers through NTR!!

Modern War Chronicles in Another World × Ruthless Spy NTR — The Battle Begins!!
author: Uchida Hiroki
